claim_summary: Complete classification of all finite singular fibers and the doubled infinite fiber of the degree-2(q-1) triangle-invariant pencil, including Cremona normalization at zero, 2-component split-conic fibers, and 4-component tangent-conic fibers.
integrity: Proof is self-contained; exact polynomial identities and enumerations are separately reproducible. Primary arXiv comparison is to 2022 v1. No external independent audit has been completed.
scientific_limitations: Classification is of this marked plane pencil over algebraically closed fields, not all triangle-invariant plane curves.
The journal version of the original paper was not available for full-text priority comparison.
No full relative discriminant scheme, stable reduction, or independent verification is claimed.
title: Exceptional fibers of the triangle-invariant Kummer-conic pencil
